title: Data Literacy and the Value of Periodic Re-testing
prompt: Some people argue that schools and employers should require everyone to sit a short test of data interpretation at regular intervals throughout their lives, so that weaknesses are identified and addressed early. Others believe that such repeated testing wastes time, creates unnecessary anxiety and does little to improve people's actual ability to understand data. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有情境与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试题。写作时请完成以下要求：1) 用一段清晰介绍题目争议并表明你的立场；2) 分别讨论“定期复测数据解读能力”的支持理由（如及早发现薄弱环节、保持技能、便于针对性改进）与反对理由（如耗时、焦虑、测试与实际能力脱节）；3) 给出你自己的明确观点，并说明理由；4) 使用具体但虚构的例子支撑论点，不要编造官方统计数据；5) 全文不少于250词，注意段落衔接与学术语气。
